name: Waardenburg症候群1型

summary.text: A subtype of Waardenburg syndrome (WS) characterized by congenital deafness, minor defects in structures arising from neural crest resulting in pigmentation anomalies of eyes, hair, and skin, in combination with dystopia canthorum.
summary.evidence: A subtype of Waardenburg syndrome (WS) c

symptoms.text: pigmentation anomalies of eyes, hair, and skin
